slides.title: 4 things your skincare should *never* meet
slides.sub: Not ingredient pairs this time. Everyday stuff.

slides.title: Retinol + face waxing
slides.body: Retinoids make skin more fragile, so wax can lift *skin along with the hair*.
slides.fix: Stop retinol 2–5 days before waxing your face.

slides.title: Benzoyl peroxide + colored fabric
slides.body: It can *bleach* colored towels, pillowcases and hair.
slides.fix: Use white towels and pillowcases, and let it dry first.

slides.title: Lime juice + sunshine
slides.body: Citrus juice on skin plus UV can cause a rash, blisters and *dark marks that last for months*.
slides.fix: Wash it off with soap and water as soon as you can.

slides.title: SPF 30 + SPF 30
slides.body: Layering SPF products doesn't add up to 60. You get roughly the *highest one* you used.
slides.fix: One proper sunscreen layer, SPF 30+, applied generously.
